item.title: 🟠 SharePoint RCE CVE-2026-45659 Added to CISA KEV After Active Exploitation
item.description:
Why this matters: RCE vulnerability — patch immediately, check for exposed attack surface.
The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency (CISA) on Wednesday added a high-severity flaw impacting Microsoft SharePoint Server to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalog, citing evidence of active exploitation. item.title: 🟠 Unpatched Argo CD Repo-Server Flaw Could Let Attackers Take Over Kubernetes Clusters
item.description:
Why this matters: Leadership context — useful for risk, budget, and vendor conversations.
Argo CD, a widely used tool for deploying software to Kubernetes, has an unpatched flaw in its repo-server component that lets an unauthenticated attacker run code, provided they can reach the component's internal network port.
